training_data: ADNI1 + ADNI GO/2 MCI (n=843, of whom 220 had elevated florbetapir PET amyloid). The earlier Shanghai MCI cohort supplied only the idea of combining ADAS13 with hippocampal volume
test_data: None separate: the cut-offs and the Cog_Vol risk groups were derived and reported on the same 843 ADNI MCI
reason: The paper is framed as validating the Shanghai risk classification in ADNI. But the authors re-set the ADAS13 and hippocampal-volume cut-offs on ADNI quartiles and built a new Cog_Vol ratio in ADNI, then reported conversion rates on the same ADNI data with no held-out split or resampling. No model fixed in Shanghai was applied unchanged, so this is neither V4 nor V3. V2 is the template's floor code ('Absence of reporting = V2 not V4').

quotes.quote: Purpose: The research is to validate the risk classification of AD developed in the Shanghai mild cognitive impairment (MCI) cohort study using ADNI data.
Cutoff points were determined based on quartiles of ADAS_cog13 and quartiles of hippocampal volume. A new parameter Cog_Vol (CoV) was created using the ratio of hippocampal volume to ADAS13 score.
We adjusted the cut-off points for ADAS13 and hippocampal volume in this analysis, because the population was different from that in Shanghai MCI cohort study.
